name: Akai Suna Ochiru Tsuki
source:
The heroine is trying to be the best magician and she has to search for a "master" who she finds worthy, but until then she isn't allowed to show her face to others. And of course as any otoge would have, she'll be dragged into all sorts of schemes and plots of her country.

[from [url=http://forum.my-neoromance.com/index.php?/topic/2654-%26-36196%3B%26-12356%3B%26-30722%3B%26-22549%3B%26-12385%3B%26-12427%3B%26-26376%3B/]MyNeoRomance Forum[/url]]
translation:
女主人公立志成为最优秀的术士。她必须寻找一位值得自己追随的“主人”，在此之前不被允许向任何人露出面容。当然，如同乙女游戏中常见的情节，她也会被卷入国家的各种阴谋与诡计。
